# Analysis Description

This report summarizes the definition of RTstop sites on the in-vitro RTstop profiling data. The dataset consists of 3.000 individual sequences each with 4 different barcodes, resulting in 12.000 individual constructs. RTstop profiling was performed under 4 conditions (GTP+NaCl, GTP+KCl, 7d+NaCl, 7d+KCl). For each condition 3 replicates experiments exist.

theme_nice <- function(size = 12) {
    baseSize = size
    largeSize = size + 2
    smallSize = size - 2
    theme_bw() +
        theme(axis.text = element_text(size = smallSize),
              axis.title = element_text(size = baseSize),
              strip.text.x = element_text(size = baseSize),
              ## legend
              legend.text = element_text(size = baseSize),
              legend.title = element_text(size = baseSize),
              ## title
              title = element_text(size = largeSize),
              plot.title = element_text(size = largeSize),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(size = smallSize),
              plot.title.position = 'plot',
              ## caption
              plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0,
                                          face= "italic", size = smallSize),

        )
}

# Definition of seed sites

RTstops are grouped into sites (RTstop sites), equivalent to binding sites for iCLIP data. The merge is based on initially identified single-nucleotide wide seed sites (PureCLIP sites in iCLIP). These sites are defined for each construct based on a cutoff defined by the mean number of RTstop events per construct (with a minimum of 6 events). The cutoff is defined based on the merge of all three biological replicates.

```{r, functions}
getInitialSites <- function(constructs, threshold, readThroughPosCutoff) {
  m = as.matrix(constructs)
  rownames(m) = names(constructs)
  # match counts matrix and thresholds by constructID
  idx = match(names(threshold), rownames(m))
  m = m[idx,]
  # apply per construct threshold on each row of matrix
  m = m > threshold
  # turn positions above threshold into granges
  gr = apply(m, 1, function(y){
    pos = which(y == TRUE)
    if (length(pos) > 0) {
      gr = GRanges(seqnames = "00000",
                   ranges = IRanges(start = pos, width = 1),
                   strand = "+")
    }
  })
  # add construct IDs
  # names(gr) = names(constructs)
  # remove ranges with no RT site
  gr = gr[lengths(gr) > 0]
  gr = as(gr, "GRangesList")
  gr = unlist(gr)
  
  # manage seqlevel/names
  # add dummy range
  gr0 = GRanges(seqnames = "00000", ranges = IRanges(start = 1, width = 1), strand = "+")
  names(gr0) = "00000"
  gr = c(gr0,gr)
  # set proper seqnames/ levels  
  seqlevels(gr) = unique(names(gr))
  seqnames(gr) = names(gr)
  # remove dummy ranges
  gr = gr[c(2:length(gr))]
  seqlevels(gr) = seqlevelsInUse(gr)
  
  # annotate ranges
  gr0 = gr[start(gr) <= readThroughPosCutoff]
  mcols(gr0)$type = "ReadThrough"
  gr1 = gr[start(gr) > readThroughPosCutoff]
  mcols(gr1)$type = "RTstop"
  gr = c(gr0,gr1)
  gr = sortSeqlevels(gr)
  gr = sort(gr)
  
  return(gr)
}

findMean <- function(constructs, minVal, readThroughPosCutoff) {
  m = as.matrix(constructs)
  # count mean only on positions with signal
  m[m == 0] = NA
  # get mean RT stops (excluding read through region)
  conMean = ceiling(rowMeans(m[,c(readThroughPosCutoff:ncol(m))], na.rm = TRUE))
  conMean[!is.finite(conMean)] = 0
  names(conMean) = names(constructs)
  # apply lower boundary
  conMean = conMean[conMean > minVal]
  return(conMean)
}

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.cap="\\textbf{Example mean coverage plots for selected constructs.} Construcs were selected randomly from the indicated groups. Groups are formed based on the mean number of crosslinks."}
# make example plots

computeExamples <- function(signal, meanVec, lower, upper, n) {
  # select examples
  s1 = sample(meanVec[meanVec < upper & meanVec > lower], n)
  # match read start counts
  m = as.matrix(signal)
  rownames(m) = names(signal)
  idx = match(names(s1), rownames(m))
  # organize dataframe for plotting
  df = data.frame(con = t(m[idx,]), pos = 1:200) %>% pivot_longer(-pos)
  df$name = sapply(strsplit(df$name,"\\."), `[`, 2)
  df$cutoff = paste0(lower, " < x > ", upper)
  df$cutoff = as.factor(df$cutoff)
  df$ord = lower
  # have means in separate df
  meanDf = data.frame(name = names(s1), mean = s1, cutoff = paste0(lower, " < x > ", upper), ord = lower)
  
  l = list(df = df, meanDf = meanDf)
  return(l)
}

conMean = findMean(constructs = constructSignalMerge$GTP_NaCL, minVal = 0, readThroughPosCutoff = 1)
set.seed(1234)
l1 = computeExamples(signal = constructSignalMerge$GTP_NaCL, meanVec = conMean, lower = 0, upper = 5, n = 3)
l2 = computeExamples(signal = constructSignalMerge$GTP_NaCL, meanVec = conMean, lower = 5, upper = 10, n = 3)
l3 = computeExamples(signal = constructSignalMerge$GTP_NaCL, meanVec = conMean, lower = 10, upper = 30, n = 3)
l4 = computeExamples(signal = constructSignalMerge$GTP_NaCL, meanVec = conMean, lower = 30, upper = 100, n = 3)

df = rbind.data.frame(l1$df, l2$df, l3$df, l4$df)
meanDf = rbind.data.frame(l1$meanDf, l2$meanDf, l3$meanDf, l4$meanDf)


p1 = ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = value, fill = cutoff)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~fct_reorder(name, ord), scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_nice() +
  geom_hline(data = meanDf, aes(yintercept = mean), colour="grey50")

p1 + plot_layout(guides='collect') &
  theme(legend.position='top')
```

# Definition of RTstop sites

All seed sites located outside of the read-through region (position 1-18) are used to compute RTstop sites based on the merge and re-size routine using *BindingSiteFinder*. RTstop seeds were merged in to 3nt wide RTstop sites and two of the three positions needed to be a seed site. Full options:

-   bsSize = 3
-   minWidth = 1
-   minCrosslinks = 2
-   minClSites = 1

Reproducibility threshold is set to the 5% quantile and has to be met by all three replicates. 

## Selection of RTstop site width

```{r}
# setup meta info
meta = data.frame(id = 1:3, condition = rep("GTP_NACL",3))
# setup signal list
sgn = list(signalPlus = constructSignal[4:6])
names(sgn$signalPlus) = paste0(meta$id, "_", meta$condition)
# setup seed sites
sitesRT = sites[sites$type == "RTstop"]
# make object
bds = BSFDataSet(ranges = sitesRT, meta = meta, signal = sgn)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
p = supportRatioPlot(bds, bsWidths = c(3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17), minClSites = 0)
ggsave(filename = "suppRatioPlot3.png", plot = p, path = "./plots/", device = "png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```

```{r, out.width="50%", out.height="50%", fig.cap="\\textbf{Signal to noise ratio plot.} Sites are calculated for the indicated width. The ratio of crosslink events within sites compared to the sum of crosslink events directly neighbouring the sites on both sides is computed."}
include_graphics("/Users/mirko/Projects/HNRNPH/02_markdowns/RTstop-profiling/01_BindingSites/condition_nacl/plots/suppRatioPlot3.png")
```

## Reproducibility

```{r, perReplicateCountFilter, fig.width=10, fig.height=4, fig.cap="\\textbf{Count filter pre replicate.} Distribution of summed up crosslinks for each replicate. The count threshold for each repliacte is indicated by a grey line (5% quantile)."}
reproducibiliyCutoffPlot(bdsMerge, max.range = 20, cutoff = 0.05)
```

```{r, perReplicateSummary, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, fig.cap="\\textbf{Reproducibility summary.} Overview of binding sites that are shared between replicates. A binding site is reproducible if supported by all three replicates."}
s1 = reproducibilityFilter(bdsMerge, cutoff = c(0.05), n.reps = c(3), returnType = "data.frame")
m = make_comb_mat(s1)

df = strsplit(names(comb_degree(m)), "")
df = do.call(rbind,df)
df = as.matrix(df)
df = apply(df, 2, as.numeric)
df = as.data.frame(df)

df$supp = rowSums(df)
rownames(df) = names(comb_degree(m))
df$status = ifelse(df$supp >= 3, "rep", "not rep")

ha = HeatmapAnnotation(
  col = list(select = c("rep" = "#004d4d", "not rep" = "grey")),
  "Sample intersections" = anno_barplot(comb_size(m), border = FALSE, gp = gpar(fill = "#595959"), height = unit(6, "cm")),
    select = df$status
)

ht = UpSet(m,
           set_order = c("X1_GTP_NACL", "X2_GTP_NACL", "X3_GTP_NACL"),
           comb_order = order(comb_size(m), decreasing = T),
           top_annotation = ha,
           comb_col = "cornflowerblue", bg_col = "white", pt_size = unit(.5, "cm") ,
           border = T, lwd = 2, bg_pt_col = "#333333"
)

ss = set_size(m)
cs = comb_size(m)
ht = draw(ht,  padding = unit(c(0, 0, 10, 0), "mm"))
od = column_order(ht)
decorate_annotation("Sample intersections", {
    grid.text(format(cs[od], big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","), x = seq_along(cs), y = unit(cs[od], "native") + unit(.1, "pt"), 
        default.units = "native", just = c("left", "bottom"), 
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "black"), rot = 45)
})
```

```{r}
bdsFinal = reproducibilityFilter(bdsMerge, cutoff = c(0.05), n.reps = c(3))
sitesReproducible = getRanges(bdsFinal)

rtracklayer::export(sitesReproducible, 
       "./data/sitesReproducibleNew.bed",
       format = "BED", 
       trackLine = new("BasicTrackLine",
                       name = "GTP-NaCl peaks reproducible",
                       description = "Merged 3nt RTstop binding sites that are reproducible by all 3 replicates") )
save(sitesReproducible, file = "./data/sitesReproducible.rda")
```

## RTstop site summary tables

```{r}
### ============================================================================
### Numbers
### ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
###
b1 = setRanges(bds, sitesRT)
c1 = coverageOverRanges(b1, returnOptions = "merge_positions_keep_replicates") %>% mcols() %>% as.matrix()

b2 = setRanges(bds, sitesProcessed)
c2 = coverageOverRanges(b2, returnOptions = "merge_positions_keep_replicates") %>% mcols() %>% as.matrix()

b3 = setRanges(bds, sitesReproducible)
c3 = coverageOverRanges(b3, returnOptions = "merge_positions_keep_replicates") %>% mcols() %>% as.matrix()

df = data.frame(nPeaks = c(length(sitesRT),
                           length(sitesProcessed),
                           length(sitesReproducible)),
                nConstructs = c(length(unique(seqnames(sitesRT))),
                                length(unique(seqnames(sitesProcessed))),
                                length(unique(seqnames(sitesReproducible)))),
                nXlinks = c(sum(c1), sum(c2), sum(c3))
)

df = format(df, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
rownames(df) = c("Seed RT", "Merged", "Reproducible")

kable(df, "latex", caption = "Processing Overview", booktabs = TRUE) 
```
